name: Honda CR250R (two-stroke)
intro: Honda's 250 two-stroke motocross bike. Premix, a top end that wears, and no lights.

add.title: Check compression and the top end
add.instructions: Do a compression test. Low or uneven numbers mean the piston and rings are due. Look at the piston through the exhaust port for scoring.
add.reason: A tired top end is the most common problem on a used two-stroke motocross bike.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual. There is no oil tank.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
